The browser ES module needs only these local JS/WASM files. No npm install,
tape package, CDN, external font, or remote color-conversion service is used.
The npm package's development/test dependencies are not bundled separately.

Import named instantiate and rendering-intent/flag constants from lcms.js.
Use instantiate({locateFile: () => localWasmURL}). Create sRGB/ICC profiles,
create an RGB8-to-CMYK8 transform, close profiles, transform RGB3 strips, and
delete the transform in finally. Do not send RGBA input to the CMYK4 path.
The cmsDoTransform wrapper has an input-extra-channel sizing issue; packing
RGB3 explicitly avoids it. WASM heap growth is allowed; strip conversion
reduces temporary allocation, while the PDF still retains full-page data.

Retrieved and verified 2026-11-23. See manifest.json for byte sizes/hashes.
